nodes.text: The line holds if the crossing holds. The shoal will not let a stake stand in their water without answering it, and I want the crossing held while it is answered. After that there is a sheet to post at Dawnmead and paper to walk the bar with. Charter paper walks through Brede's bar. That is his rule and I did not write it either.
Here is the sheet. Do not lose it in the water.
Then the crossing holds with two hands. It has before.
